title: Lanternfall — The Last Keeper of Ashfall Isle

concept.title: Lanternfall — The Last Keeper of Ashfall Isle
concept.logline: Relight Ashfall Isle's three beacons and the Great Lighthouse before the storm makes landfall.
concept.source_prompt: Lanternfall — The Last Keeper of Ashfall Isle. A stormy dusk island adventure. You arrive by boat at a small harbour village as a storm gathers on the horizon. Keeper Maren, the old lighthouse keeper, asks you to relight the island's three beacon lanterns before the storm makes landfall. Ember, a small fox-spirit made of warm light, follows you everywhere. The lantern cores that feed the beacons are hidden in the Sunken Ruins, at the Whispering Grove shrine and at the Cliffside Watch; hovering Stormwisp sentinels patrol the ruins and sting anyone who strays too close. Relight the three beacons, then climb to the Great Lighthouse on the summit and light it to drive the storm back. Dusk amber light against storm blue, rain, wind, the sea all around.
concept.mood: stormy dusk, lonely but hopeful — warm lantern light holding out against a blue-black storm
concept.player_fantasy: The last traveller willing to carry fire up a drowning island, with a fox made of light at your heels.

key_locations.name: Ashfall Harbour
key_locations.description: A cluster of stone cottages and lantern posts around the harbour where your boat ties up; Keeper Maren waits by the quay.

key_locations.name: Sunken Ruins
key_locations.description: Half-drowned arches and broken walls of the old keepers' hall, patrolled by Stormwisps. A lantern core lies in the rubble.

key_locations.name: Whispering Grove
key_locations.description: A ring of wind-bent pines around a moss-covered shrine where the first lantern core was hidden.

key_locations.name: Cliffside Watch
key_locations.description: A lonely watchtower on the sea cliffs with its beacon brazier gone cold; the third core is kept there.

key_locations.name: Great Lighthouse
key_locations.description: The island's tall striped lighthouse on the summit. Light it last, once the three beacons burn, to turn the storm.

key_locations.name: Old Dock
key_locations.description: A weathered jetty on the far shore where Fisher Tomas mends his nets and trades rumours.

characters.name: Keeper Maren
characters.description: The island's last lighthouse keeper: grey-haired, hooded, a brass lantern always in hand. Gives the quest to relight the beacons.

characters.name: Ember
characters.description: A small fox-spirit of warm amber light who follows the player and glows brighter near lantern cores.

characters.name: Fisher Tomas
characters.description: A weathered fisherman at the old dock who trades herbs and knows where the Stormwisps roam.

characters.name: Stormwisp
characters.description: A hovering storm spirit of blue lightning that patrols the Sunken Ruins and stings intruders.

characters.name: Stormwisp
characters.description: A second hovering storm spirit of blue lightning circling the ruins' far wall.

objectives_outline: Speak with Keeper Maren at Ashfall Harbour
Recover the lantern cores from the Sunken Ruins, the Whispering Grove and the Cliffside Watch
Climb to the Great Lighthouse on the summit and light it
hazards: Stormwisp sentinels patrol the Sunken Ruins
The storm makes landfall when the timer runs out

You are badly hurt. Back off and recover.

Thunder rolls closer. Five minutes until the storm makes landfall.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Maren
nodes.text: So you've come to Ashfall Harbour at last. I am Keeper Maren. Relight Ashfall Isle's three beacons and the Great Lighthouse before the storm makes landfall.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Keeper Maren
nodes.text: Back again. Ashfall Harbour is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Maren
nodes.text: Go to Sunken Ruins, then Whispering Grove. Whatever still remembers Lanternfall — The Last Keeper of Ashfall Isle is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Maren
nodes.text: They say Ashfall Harbour was built on what was left of an older place. Stormy dusk, lonely but hopeful — warm lantern light holding out against a blue-black storm, even then. Ask the stones and they won't argue.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Maren
nodes.text: Sunken Ruins: Half-drowned arches and broken walls of the old keepers' hall, patrolled by Stormwisps. A lantern core lies in the rubble.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Maren
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of Lanternfall — The Last Keeper of Ashfall Isle back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Maren
nodes.text: Whispering Grove: A ring of wind-bent pines around a moss-covered shrine where the first lantern core was hidden.

nodes.speaker: Ember
nodes.text: Ember circles your feet, then looks toward Sunken Ruins as if it already knows the way.

actions.value: follow_player

nodes.speaker: Ember
nodes.text: Ember sniffs the air. Something about Sunken Ruins has it restless.

actions.value: idle
follow_player

nodes.speaker: Ember
nodes.text: It turns toward Sunken Ruins. Half-drowned arches and broken walls of the old keepers' hall, patrolled by Stormwisps. A lantern core lies in the rubble.

nodes.speaker: Fisher Tomas
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Ashfall Harbour. Fisher Tomas's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Fisher Tomas
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of Lanternfall — The Last Keeper of Ashfall Isle that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Fisher Tomas
nodes.text: People say lights move at Cliffside Watch after dark. I don't go there myself.
